title: Morning Brief, Wed 18 Nov 2026: India beat 10-man Pakistan 2-1 in the SAFF Championship final in Dhaka (Mandi 88'), record 10th title, first three-in-a-row (lead); UP draft voter roll 13.58 crore, claims till 16 Dec, booth camps 21/22/28/29 Nov, final roll 4 Jan 2027; CAQM revokes GRAP Stage III in Delhi-NCR (order 17 Nov, AQI 204), Stages I-II stay, 30 Oct construction/demolition dust order continues; Quad's first summit in two years in Manila: first joint patrol-aircraft exercise 2027, first business leaders' forum early 2027.
headline: India Beat 10-Man Pakistan for Record 10th SAFF Title

image.author: FahimHP (own work, taken 25 May 2025)
image.subject: National Stadium, Dhaka (venue of the 17 Nov SAFF final): pitch, running track and renovated stands from pitch-side seats; a few tiny distant groundstaff, not identifiable

fact_sources.fact: India 2 (Suhail Ahmad Bhat 60', Sandip Mandi 88') Pakistan 1 (Alamgir Ghazi 45+1'), SAFF Championship final, National Stadium Dhaka, Tue 17 Nov 2026; record 10th title; first three straight titles; Pakistan's Junaid Shah sent off after VAR review; Pakistan's first SAFF final

UP draft roll (Special Summary Revision 2027) published 17 Nov by CEO Navdeep Rinwa: 13,58,68,905 voters, about 18.84 lakh more than the 10 Apr final roll; claims/objections till 16 Dec; camps at all 1,73,730 polling stations on 21, 22, 28, 29 Nov, 10 am-4 pm; Forms 6/7/8; final roll 4 Jan 2027
CAQM revoked GRAP Stage III across Delhi-NCR by order of 17 Nov; daily average AQI 204; Stages I and II stay; 30 Oct order restricting dust-raising construction and demolition continues

7th Quad Leaders' Summit, Manila, 17 Nov (Modi, Trump, Australian PM Albanese, Japanese PM Takaichi), first in two years (previous Wilmington 2024); the four countries' patrol aircraft to hold first joint maritime exercise in a Quad context in 2027; first Quad Business Leaders' Forum early 2027
